project.name: Ananta
project.design_philosophy: High breathing room, clean typography, low cognitive load, absolute structural simplicity. Anti-clutter.

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Trading execution cockpits require authority, precision, and focus. A matte silver dark theme provides a premium, zero-distraction environment that emphasizes the data rather than the UI.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: 'Control Room' grid but generously spaced (gap-6 to gap-8). Focus on 1px solid borders and flat surfaces.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous. Panels require min p-6 (24px) or p-8 (32px) to guarantee breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Subtle. max 8px (rounded-md to rounded-lg). No pill shapes.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid brushed silver (#2A2D35). Critical: NO glowing grid lines, background patterns, or neon clutter.

executive_header.row_a: Portfolio Stats. Large white/silver Account Value, Deployed Positions with bracket count (e.g. $150.00 (2)).
executive_header.row_b: Bot Brain status strip (Scanned 10 | Setups 8 | Rejected 7 | Qualified 1 | Regime: Bullish). Matte silver text on darker panel. Monospace numbers.

dashboard_cockpit.watchlist_ribbon: Horizontal scrollable cards (BTC, ETH, SOL...). Flat design. Clicking changes workspace. data-testid='watchlist-[asset]'
dashboard_cockpit.workspace: 100% Wide Chart Space. (Since 'Why No Trade' moved to Reports to declutter, the main cockpit is purely focused on the single wide 4H candlestick of the selected asset).
dashboard_cockpit.analytics_carousel: Swipeable anti-clutter carousel below chart. Slide 1: Counterfactual ring chart (Correct Rejections vs Missed Opportunities). Slide 2: Confidence Distribution histogram (0.50-0.59, 0.60-0.69...). Only 1 visible at a time.

footer.trade_stepper: Trade Lifecycle horizontal stepper (Detected -> Qualified -> Entered -> Trailing Armed -> Exited). Muted silver for inactive, Matte Silver for active, Green for completed.
footer.executions_table: Today's Executions flat table. Empty state: centered muted 'No executions today. Tracking zones...'.

datalog_reports_tab.name: DataLogs/Reports
datalog_reports_tab.description: Moved complex diagnostics here to keep home decluttered.
components: 'Why No Trade?' diagnostic widget (bulleted checklist: [✓] Support Zone | [✓] RSI Reset | [✗] Volume Exhaustion | Result: NO TRADE)

settings_tab.name: Settings
settings_tab.description: Standard configuration pane following the matte silver UI spec.

media_and_assets.logo_instructions: Implement the brand logo using the provided URL. FADE THE DAMARUKA: Since this is a static image, use a CSS overlay (e.g., a linear gradient from transparent to the background color at the bottom of the logo) or CSS `mask-image` to visually 'fade' or 'ghost' the damaruka (the lower base element) into the background.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Subtle background lightening (e.g., bg-[#1A1D24]). Explicitly set hover text colors to #E2E4E9.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Fast, precise. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
interactions_and_motion.animations: Minimal. No bouncy effects. Strictly functional.

testing_guidelines.data_testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. Examples: `data-testid='portfolio-value'`, `data-testid='watchlist-btc-card'`, `data-testid='nav-reports'`.
